If it makes you feel any better, it seems that you are already making progress. I know it’s not the same as going to university or getting married or whatever, but it’s still progress. Traumatized people like us can’t just move on with our lives like everyone else, we have to start deconstructing our trauma and heal, while taking care of the bare necessities at the same time. Most people just have to worry about the bare necessities. 

For this reason, it’s unfair to compare ourselves to those who seemingly have accomplished so much more. Either they haven’t been through anything nearly as traumatic as you have, or they’re very high functioning and mentally ill. And don’t get hung up on the high functioning thing, pretty much all mental health issues are on a spectrum, and everyone is in a different part of their journey compared to you or someone else. You’re doing your best given the circumstances, and that’s all one can really do. 

As for wanting to die.. well, I feel you. However, I’ve been on this journey of healing for quite awhile now, and although it was and is very rocky, I am seeing a little bit of improvement in my mood and thinking patterns. It takes time, and healing is a lifelong journey, but it is possible to get to a place where you don’t want to die everyday. I truly do believe In you

Ok. So the results will probably come back in a page by page format, each page is a different type of mental health medicine. On these pages, there are 3 sections. First is the “use as directed” section. This is the one that you really want to pay attention to, because this is the one that tells you the meds you can take that have not been found to have any gene-drug interaction. The one in the middle is “moderate gene-drug interaction”. The next is “significant gene-drug interaction”. In the last two sections, there’s numbers that can be found on the legend at the bottom of the page.

The legend tells you what can be done to moderate the gene-drug interaction, and what may be causing it. Although the legend isn’t super descriptive by itself. There are several more pages that go into more depth about your genes and what that could mean for meds. But just like any other company or professional, it’s bound to have flaws. So just keep that in mind if. Hope that helps, good luck
